discovery.observedLinks: Time management create/delete/update/list, predictive task create/update; EnterpriseTime/TaskProperty/Agent paths already in local official-source index.

authentication.validateType: Int required:1 departmentId auth;2 enterpriseId auth
authentication.sign: String required,lowercase32 MD5 per auth rules

timeType.semanticLimit: No extra interval parameter and no detailed continuous/interval interpretation is stated.

create.response: result:Int(0 success,-1 failure),description:String,data:EnterpriseTime; example integer fields may be string encoded

identity.name: String optional
identity.rule: id or name required; they cannot both be empty; no documented precedence when both provided

update.conditionalRules: Same type/date/week conditions as create; optional fields omitted keep previous values. Explicitly send opposite-mode empty fields when changing type rather than leaving incompatible dates/weekdays.
update.nameMutationLimit: name is also a selector. No explicit rename/newName semantics documented; prefer immutable name/edit by id or a distinct rename clarification.

delete.identity: id:Int or name:String, not both empty

list.response: data is an array List<EnterpriseTime>, not data.list
list.pagination: No offset/limit/page parameters documented; do not fabricate pagination at provider boundary
list.activation: No active/enabled/status field or API is documented for time conditions

modelDiscrepancies: EnterpriseTime model (document4) omits timeType, but current create/update both explicitly require it and list/current examples contain it. Preserve it using CRUD evidence.
The create type2 response example omits timeType; this example omission must not override required request contract.

taskIntegration.applicability: task/create explicitly supports both types; all listed timing fields are in common parameters, not prediction-only parameters. task/update has same common timing fields; taskId:String required. TaskProperty is the read model, not a separate write endpoint.

autoTaskType.note: Different enum from EnterpriseTime.timeType=1/2. Doc says used together with autoStart/autoStop for calling in daily time windows, but does not state both switches must always equal1.

autoStart.conditional: when1 at least one of autoStartDay/autoStartTime is supplied

autoStop.conditional: when1 at least one of autoStopDay/autoStopTime is supplied

forceEndFlag.meaning: end task at configured finish time even if numbers remain; ended task cannot restart

taskIntegration.separationFromInbound: ivrRouter.ruleTimeProperty uses semicolon-separated IDs; task fields use comma-separated IDs. Do not reuse the separator.
taskIntegration.separationFromRetry: Task retry interval/timeType are different fields and concepts; do not replace retry intervals with EnterpriseTime.timeType.
taskIntegration.templateInteraction: task/create documents explicitly provided parameters override template; omitted or empty parameters can inherit template values. A UI saying no time restriction must not silently inherit unreviewed template restriction.
notDocumented: Detailed matching/composition of multiple allowed and forbidden conditions and overlaps
Exact continuous versus interval meaning inside EnterpriseTime.timeType
Deleting/updating a time condition already referenced by running tasks and when changes take effect
Behavior of empty timing-strategy string on task/update (clear versus retain)
A supplier-side tenantId boundary for time conditions
Overnight startTime>endTime is not supported by documented ordering

recommendedLocalConstraints: Maintain enterprise-level identity and uniqueness while tenant ownership/authorization remains local and never enters supplier fields.
Select existing authorized time-condition IDs, not names or local-only IDs.
Preserve opposite-mode empty strings and real valid Gregorian dates/24h times. Equal endpoints are permitted by documented <=; do not invent strict inequality.
Protect deletion and impactful edits when local tasks or inbound routes reference a condition; identify this as local protection, not documented supplier refusal.
Do not add activation switches, interval-minute inputs, synthetic holidays, or extra task scheduling algorithms without a documented basis.

talkState.label: 话务状态
talkState.note: This combines login/device state. Agent.status=1 only means online and cannot be shown as idle.

enabled.label: 启用状态
enabled.note: Independent from telephone state; disabled/online should not be conflated.

configuration.label: 配置状态
configuration.meaning: Local provision/configuration processing outcome, e.g.同步成功、失败、待提交; not an official Agent state field
configuration.evidence: Agent model does not define syncStatus; runtime creates/maps local syncStatus in account-seat / alicti-seat-import / alicti-demo.

seatColumns.currentRuntimeObservation: agent-center.js current list already renders state and active and no longer shows syncStatus in the main seat list; separate skill relation/configuration records still use local syncStatus.
